svg.text: Baseline is current Request 6 plus the B1913 covariance-aware extension. J1141 and J1906 are added as source-specific surrogate likelihoods with their nuisance structures left explicit.
J1906 branch weights at GR: ext_i = 1.000, xdot_i = 0.000
Interpretation: J1141 stays a genuine low-side source. J1906 becomes a nuisance-sensitive mixed source because its xdot-conditioned branch moves toward positive s.
